provenance: Property from a Southern California Estate | | This narrative painting from the Ramayana depicts Rama and Sita departing Ayodhya for their forest exile. Executed in the Oriya Pattachitra tradition of Orissa, the work is distinguished by its meticulous hand-painted detail and elongated, stylized figures articulated in firm black contour. Natural pigments create a vivid yet harmonious palette, while the pale ground is animated with repeating floral motifs. The composition is framed by richly ornamented borders and arching vegetal forms that structure the scene. The clarity of line, decorative patterning, and narrative emphasis exemplify the enduring devotional and storytelling character of Pattachitra painting (cf. Christie's, New York, 20 March 2013, lot 293).
